انتصبتما (form VIII)
# اِنْتَصَبْتُمَا (intaṣabtumā) /in.ta.sˤab.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِنْتَصَبَ (intaṣaba)
# اُنْتُصِبْتُمَا (untuṣibtumā) /un.tu.sˤib.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِنْتَصَبَ (intaṣaba)
